data.text: My family taught me to leave enough fish for the village’s next meal, not just today’s catch. Luke, I’m willing to help, but I won’t commit to 15 tons until we’ve confirmed the clinic’s need and agreed on a plan together. Let’s contact the clinic now and ask whether $50,000 today plus a funded arrangement for the remaining $10,000 would restore treatment. If a full $60,000 really is essential today and no other funds are available, I’d support 12 tons each rather than putting the whole burden on four of us, followed by 6 tons each next month to rebuild the stock. Luke, can you put us in touch with the clinic?
